question: How many drones will Ukraine's Air Force report Russia launched at Ukraine on the night of 12–13 November 2026?

calls.reasoning: Reference class: Ukrainian Air Force overnight drone launch totals Oct-Nov 2026. Typical nights cluster 88-180 (median ~140); big wave nights (280-580) occur roughly every 5-7 nights, so any single date carries ~15-20% wave risk, producing a heavy right tail. Intensifying energy campaign into winter and a ~2,000/week drone tempo nudge the median slightly above the historical median. No human market found on Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmakers. Above 1000 is a minor tail (the campaign record is 580).
calls.dossier:
- Nightly (from 18:00) Air Force drone launch totals, per Ukrinform/UP/Interfax and question background: 14-15 Oct 580 (Ukrinform, record of campaign); 17-18 Oct 180 + 1 Iskander (UP 18 Oct); 19-20 Oct 165; 22-23 Oct 176 (92 jet) (Ukrinform); 23-24 Oct 126; 25-26 Oct 140; 26-27 Oct 280; 27-28 Oct 88; 28-29 Oct 112; 29-30 Oct 113; 30-31 Oct 134 (72 jet) (Ukrinform 31 Oct); 31 Oct-1 Nov 433, 371 neutralised (Ukrinform/UP 1 Nov).
- Daytime waves reported separately: 1 Nov 06:30-19:00 326 UAVs (55 jet) + 6 Banderol (Ukrinform 1 Nov); 31 Oct daytime ~122+ downed. Daytime counts are excluded by the criteria. One search snippet described the 326 as 'from 19:00 on November 1'; the window is ambiguous, so it may or may not be the 1-2 Nov overnight figure.
- Zelensky weekly figure (~1 Nov): 1,940 attack drones, 1,580+ guided bombs and 44 missiles in one week, all times of day (~277/day).
- Component rates over the 13 nights 14 Oct-1 Nov: share of nights >=280 is about 3/13; share of nights 85-180 is about 10/13; minimum 88.
- Ballistic missile counts no longer published since 11 Aug 2026; drone headline count is still published nightly.
- Status quo: a 'typical' night, not a wave night; the date (Thu-Fri night) has no known special significance.
- Resolves off the Air Force Telegram morning report of 13 Nov (headline drone total, decoys included in the headline, no subtypes added), not off daytime reports or the number shot down.
- Event window: 18:00 Kyiv 12 Nov -> morning 13 Nov 2026; as of 2 Nov 0% elapsed (about 11 days ahead).
- Market check: no Polymarket/Kalshi/Manifold/bookmaker contract found.
- Searched for but not found: the 1-2 Nov overnight report (not yet seen), Russian production/stockpile numbers for Nov 2026, and a weather outlook.

calls.reasoning: Ordinary October-November 2026 nights cluster at 88-180 drones (median ~134). Wave nights of 280, 433 and 580 happened on about 3 of ~18 sampled nights, spaced 5-12 days apart, so 12-13 November has about a 15% chance of being a wave night. The winter energy campaign and ~1,940 drones a week push slightly upward. A Trump-brokered energy truce is a small downside risk because Moscow has not committed. The result is right-skewed: median ~143, fat upper tail. Going above 1,000 would need a record-shattering night, priced at 1%. No human market found.
calls.reconciliation: The runs disagreed only on judgment: how often wave nights happen (Run 2's ~11% vs ~15-20% for the others) and the median (136-150). Re-counting the distinct nights reported across all dossiers gives about 3 waves in ~18 nights (~16%) and an ordinary-night median of ~134. I kept a ~15% wave probability given the intensifying winter campaign, so my median lands near 143 and my p90 near 360. The 1-2 November figure was unknown in every run and can't be settled without web access, but it matters little 11 days out. All runs found no market, and I retrieved nothing myself. I agree with Run 3's reference class and use a dispersion close to its estimate.

disagreements.verdict: Distinct reported nights give ~16%; I adopted ~15%
Pooled ordinary nights have a median of ~134; with the wave mix the overall median is ~143
